# The Study Syndicate Library

> Premium 24-hour air-conditioned study library in Shastri Nagar, Jammu (180004), with personal numbered cabins, high-speed Wi-Fi, free mock tests and notes, and Sunday doubt sessions.

The Study Syndicate Library is a self-study space for students preparing for competitive exams. It is open 24 hours a day, every day. Reservations and enquiries happen by phone or WhatsApp.

## Key facts

- Address: Above Choudhary Car Accessories, Digiana, Shastri Nagar, Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir 180004 (near Jandyal Bakers)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 90550 66867
- Hours: open 24 hours, every day
- Opening offer: ₹999 for the first month, instead of ₹1,200 a month (limited time)
- Facilities: personal numbered cabins with lamps and power points, fully AC silent hall, high-speed Wi-Fi, CCTV, RO water, refreshment zone, books and study resources
- Free for members: mock tests (Maths, Reasoning, English, GS) conducted and checked, study notes, career counselling
- Sunday doubt sessions: every Sunday, 5 PM to 9 PM, covering Maths, Reasoning, English, GS and general competitive exam guidance
